description: Process mining (Pm) would be the right solution if you are suffering from inefficiencies and inaccuracies in your ongoing business processes. In PmBI Pro, you can enjoy many plus features of doing process mining in Power BI to have both Pm and BI in one platform simultaneously. A unique feature of "process animation" enables you to simulate the real execution of processes based on cases or variants making intelligence alive. Moreover, you can support the end users to change useful visual settings at the dashboard level and also import the complete time of activity for calculating the service time. Discover, analyse, and improve!
keywords: PmBI Pro - Advanced Process Mining by ProcessM
